item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 20 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 20 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 2:00 AM, 15 August 2026(Saturday)

Light rains are expected over Tarlac(San Clemente, Camiling, Mayantoc, San Jose), Bataan(Morong, Bagac, Mariveles), Nueva Ecija(Llanera, Cabanatuan, Talavera, Santo Domingo, General Mamerto Natividad, Palayan), Bulacan(San Jose del Monte, Santa Maria, Marilao), Batangas(Calatagan, Lian) and Rizal(Rodriguez).

Light rains affecting Zambales(Santa Cruz, Candelaria, Masinloc) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 5:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.
